tasks.label: moCURA: executar no WSL
args: WORKSPACE=$(wslpath '${workspaceFolder}'); cd "$WORKSPACE" || exit 1; if [ -f "$HOME/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh" ]; then CONDA_SH="$HOME/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh"; elif [ -f "$HOME/anaconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh" ]; then CONDA_SH="$HOME/anaconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh"; elif [ -f "$HOME/miniforge3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh" ]; then CONDA_SH="$HOME/miniforge3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh"; elif [ -f "$HOME/mambaforge/etc/profile.d/conda.sh" ]; then CONDA_SH="$HOME/mambaforge/etc/profile.d/conda.sh"; elif [ -f "/opt/conda/etc/profile.d/conda.sh" ]; then CONDA_SH="/opt/conda/etc/profile.d/conda.sh"; else echo 'ERRO: conda.sh não foi encontrado no WSL.'; echo 'Execute: find $HOME /opt -path "*/etc/profile.d/conda.sh" 2>/dev/null'; exit 127; fi; source "$CONDA_SH"; conda activate mocura_env || exit 1; mkdir -p example_output; python mocura.py --results-dir /mnt/c/dev/results --output-dir example_output --threads 20 --only-circularized --fig-format png --dpi 300; EXIT_CODE=$?; conda deactivate || true; exit $EXIT_CODE

tasks.label: diag-wsl-sif
args: cd /mnt/c/dev/moCURA && echo HI && ls -lh mocura.sif mocura_plain.sif && file mocura.sif && file mocura_plain.sif

tasks.label: diag-run-mocura-sif
args: cd /mnt/c/dev/moCURA && ./mocura.sif python --version; echo EXIT_WRAPPER:$?; singularity exec mocura.sif python --version; echo EXIT_EXEC:$?

tasks.label: diag-exact-help
args: cd /mnt/c/dev/moCURA && singularity exec mocura.sif python mocura.py --help; echo EXIT1:$?; ./mocura.sif python mocura.py --help; echo EXIT2:$?

tasks.label: diag-conda-singularity
args: source "$HOME/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh" 2>/dev/null || source "$HOME/anaconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh" 2>/dev/null || true; conda activate mocura_env; echo CONDA_PREFIX:$CONDA_PREFIX; which singularity; singularity --version; cd /mnt/c/dev/moCURA; singularity exec mocura.sif python --version; echo EXIT:$?

tasks.label: diag-fix-command
args: source "$HOME/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh" 2>/dev/null || true; conda activate mocura_env; conda run -n mocura_env bash -lc 'which singularity; singularity --version' ; /usr/bin/singularity exec /mnt/c/dev/moCURA/mocura.sif python --version

tasks.label: diag-fix-command-2
args: source "$HOME/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh" 2>/dev/null || true; conda activate mocura_env; which singularity; singularity --version; /usr/bin/singularity exec /mnt/c/dev/moCURA/mocura.sif python --version
